nodes.question: How is the frugal self-identity different from the thrifty self-identity in terms of its link to sustainable consumption?
nodes.answer: The frugal self-identity, with avoidance of resource waste, is likely to be more strongly linked to sustainable consumption compared to the thrifty self-identity, as per Gatersleben et al., 2019 and Stance, 2021.
